title: Natural Aim Assist Fabric 26.2
objective: Design and implement a Java Fabric client mod for Minecraft 26.2 that provides configurable natural-feeling aim assistance driven by player mouse intent, target proximity, acceleration limits, target commitment, and Mod Menu configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Targets Minecraft 26.2, Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, and Fabric API 0.160.0+26.2.
Builds as a client-side Fabric mod and exposes a Mod Menu configuration screen.
Aim assistance layers corrections on top of real player mouse movement instead of hard-locking rotations.
Includes configurable enable state, preset/strength, FOV, range, vertical assistance, attack requirement, weapons-only behavior, target filters, and visibility filtering.
Implements target commitment, correction acceleration/deceleration limits, dynamic aim-region behavior, distance scaling, and disengagement when the player deliberately pulls away.
Persists configuration and includes a concise implementation/design plan.
GitHub Actions verifies the Java 25 Fabric build and uploads the built JAR.
